candidates.topic: Last Quarter Moon in Gemini — Mental Crossroads
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Gemini right now — and it's forcing a decision you've been avoiding for weeks.
candidates.video_title: Last Quarter Moon in Gemini Is Exposing Your Indecision
candidates.video_description: The Last Quarter Moon in Gemini at 1.6° is a mental crossroads moment. With the Sun in Virgo analyzing every detail, this lunation asks you to cut through the noise and commit. Which story are you finally letting go of?
candidates.script: You're being pulled in two directions right now — and the sky is the reason. The Last Quarter Moon is sitting in Gemini at just 1.6°, locking into a tense angle with the Virgo Sun. Gemini wants every option open. Virgo demands a decision. This moon phase is not about gathering more information — it's about releasing the version of yourself that refuses to choose. Which story are you finally willing to let go of?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — The Rules That Aren't Working
candidates.teaser: Saturn is retrograde in Aries right now — and the structure you built on urgency is cracking.
candidates.video_title: Saturn Retrograde in Aries Is Calling Out Your Shortcuts
candidates.video_description: Saturn is currently retrograde at 13.5° Aries, forcing a review of the systems, boundaries, and ambitions you rushed into. In astrology, Saturn retrograde is when karma becomes visible. The shortcuts you took are showing up — right now.
candidates.script: Saturn is retrograde in Aries right now — and that combination doesn't mess around. Aries moves fast and asks questions later. Saturn retrograde makes you go back and answer every single one. At 13.5°, Saturn is in the middle of a deep review of the structures you built on impulse, the promises you made out of urgency, the rules you set and then quietly broke. The bill doesn't arrive late. It arrives exactly on time.

candidates.topic: Three Outer Planets Retrograde — Neptune and Pluto Specifics
candidates.teaser: Neptune and Pluto are both retrograde right now — and together they're dismantling things you can't even name yet.
candidates.video_title: Neptune & Pluto Retrograde: The Slow Demolition No One Talks About
candidates.video_description: Neptune is retrograde at 3.6° Aries and Pluto at 3.5° Aquarius right now, both moving backward alongside Saturn. In astrology, these two retrograde together signal deep, generational dissolution — the kind of transformation that works beneath the surface before it surfaces.
candidates.script: Neptune and Pluto are both retrograde right now — and most people have no idea what that actually means. Neptune at 3.6° Aries is quietly dissolving the identity you thought was solid. Pluto at 3.5° Aquarius is tearing down the collective systems we built our certainty on. These aren't dramatic breakdowns. They're slow, invisible demolitions. The change happened weeks ago. You're only just starting to feel it.

candidates.topic: Uranus in Gemini — The Astrology Cycle That Rewires How You Think
candidates.teaser: Uranus just moved into Gemini — and historically, every time this happens, the world changes how it communicates forever.
candidates.video_title: Uranus in Gemini: The Transit That Rewires Human Communication
candidates.video_description: Uranus is currently at 5.7° Gemini — a placement that only happens every 84 years. In astrological tradition, Uranus in Gemini correlates with radical shifts in information, technology, and how humans exchange ideas. The last time it was here, mass media was born.
candidates.script: Uranus is in Gemini right now — and that only happens every 84 years. The last time Uranus was here, the world was figuring out how to send information across impossible distances. In astrology, Uranus rules disruption, and Gemini rules communication and the mind. Every time these two meet, something fundamental about how humans think, speak, and connect gets torn apart and rebuilt. We are inside that moment right now.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 6th House — The House of Daily Life
candidates.teaser: The most underrated house in your birth chart isn't the 8th or the 12th — it's the one hiding your daily patterns.
candidates.video_title: The 6th House: The Most Underrated Placement in Your Chart
candidates.video_description: The 6th house rules daily routine, health habits, and the quality of your ordinary days — yet most people ignore it completely. In traditional astrology, this house was called the House of Illness, but modern astrologers see it as the blueprint for sustainable living.
candidates.script: Everyone obsesses over the 8th house for transformation and the 12th for hidden enemies — but the house that actually runs your life? It's the 6th. Your daily routine, your body's patterns, what breaks down when you stop taking care of yourself — all of it lives here. In traditional astrology it was called the House of Illness. Modern astrologers call it the House of Service and Health. Either way, ignore it and your chart will find a way to remind you.
